about_the_game:
Vault of the Void: The Weaver

One of many skittering siblings, she has woven her own path and returned with friends in tow. Spin a web of control and domination with a deadly new character: The Weaver!

This sinister heroine weaves together the threads of battle with a style unlike any other. The Weaver commands a host of (mostly) adorable Pets, creatures bound in silk and shadow, who lend their aid to your cause.

As with other heroes, the Weaver introduces her own pool of new cards and artifacts, including a brand new card type...

Your New Best Friends

Take dozens of charming new friends (and a few parasitic infestations) on walks, flights, swims, and skitters as you create lasting memories and powerful decks.

Easy to Weave, Hard to Unravel

Her playstyle rewards careful sequencing, resource management, and the instinct to Weave and Unravel her own Pets at just the right moment! With your band of courageous Pets, each with unique actions - combined with delayed Infest effects and widespread Rage scaling, you'll need careful timing and a PhD in Biology, Veterinary Science, or a related field. 

DLC Contents

  • A new unique class: The Weaver!

  • Over 90+ New Cards

  • Over 50+ Unique Artifacts

  • 3 New Challenge Coins, unique to the Weaver (plus the ability to play her on 20 existing CCs) 

  • An old Guardian takes a newly sinister approach to a long-gone sibling...
